review.official:
Hoshiguma is an elite
Operator
from the Special Ops Team of the
L.G.D.
There are several charges against her on record.
After intervention from Chief
Wei Yenwu
, L.G.D. made an exception to admit her into its Special Ops division based on her exceptional abilities and field performance. She exhibited remarkable professionalism in handling violent crime, protecting VIPs, disaster response and emergency rescue.
Currently a
defender
assisting
Rhodes Island
operations
, Hoshiguma provides tactical execution and command support.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Hoshiguma showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Hoshiguma rarely comes into contact with Originium.

A towering female Oni. 
Unlike Madam Ch'en, she dresses very casually but easily reminds others of her post with her speech and demeanor. 
She loves to drink, but no one has seen her inebriated to date.

As ranks go, Madam Ch'en is Hoshiguma's superior. But based on service history, Hoshiguma joined the L.G.D. before Ch'en and the two are long-time colleagues, so it's little wonder the line between them is almost invisible. 
What is unexpected is that Hoshiguma knows more about Lungmen then Ch'en. She has extensive knowledge about its criminal underworld, law enforcement, politics, economics, education, and foreign policy among others, and is unafraid to hold strong opinions about those topics.
She is indeed a rare combination of martial and scholarly talent.

Hoshiguma is no less aggressive than her kin in battle, usually the fiercest and most courageous on the field. 
However, she also possesses a quality most Oni sorely lack - composure. 
Her self-discipline is discernible in her speech and demeanor, as well as in battle. She has fully conquered the recklessness in her Oni blood. 
This may have perhaps stemmed from her past.

According to L.G.D. record, Hoshiguma was already an anomaly even when was part of the criminal underworld. She never preyed on the weak, was always righteous, loyal and helpful, and could drink anyone under the table... In short, a throwback to the martial heroes of the East's long-forgotten history. 
It's likely that these qualities allowed her to break tradition and gain a position in the L.G.D.
But it's also clear from the files that Hoshiguma is no different now than when she first arrived at Lungmen, so the question remains how did she manage to gain her composure and knowledge, and why did she work for criminals in Lungmen? 
Even if these stories took place before she arrived in Lungmen, she is still shrouded in mystery.

I am willing to lend this person, Hoshiguma, to you.
Since we want to get off on a right foot, let me give you a piece of advice, Doctor. 
If you think that she's a reasonable person, that just proves that you do not fully understand her. 
That shield... Well, until she tells you where that shield came from...
You don't know the real her. 
—Wei Yenwu

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Relax, Doctor. I'll keep you safe.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Lots of new recruits lately, many new faces. Don't let your guard down.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If something happens, don't forget to use the emergency communication channel. Just call me and I'll come running.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I sound cold when I talk? I'm on the clock. I'm a lot less serious when I'm off.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island needs more than just combat Operators. You need experts in education, PR, and all kinds of stuff.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I used to only get called in for the nastiest fights, but now every fight is a nasty one.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This shield has a name: Hannya. I brought it from my hometown. Its 'father' and mine were old friends. Back in the L.G.D., my superiors would always tease me about it, but together we've proven that a shield makes a great weapon, and so do I.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hannya's tasted plenty of Lungmen gangster blood. I never thought it'd win me many friends, but the ones who looked down on me started showing me some respect after all that had happened. Or maybe they're just scared of how big I am? What do you think?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: How about another shot...? Oh, you've had enough? Don't sweat it... I can carry you back to your room if you pass out. What? That worries you even more? C'mon, don't be a buzzkill.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hm? Heh. Nothing. Just guarding you, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hoshiguma, Defender Operator. I'll be your shield, your blade, your fortress. Very glad to meet you, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's all thanks to your teaching, Doctor.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm honored.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: No one tells me where I'm going, and no one can stop me once I make up my mind. And now—I've made up my mind to follow you, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I will protect everyone.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Protecting Rhodes Island is my responsibility too.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I want everyone to get home safe.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: If you've got a reason to fight, you've got a reason to die!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes, Sir.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Not one step backwards.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Not one step forwards.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hannya will crush you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: If you want to hurt my friends, you have to go through my shield first.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Seeing is believing.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hannya, unleash the rage your father poured into you!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The harder the journey, the stronger you'll become.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hurting my friends right in front of me? I'll make you pay!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Are you hurt? I'm sorry. I failed.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Fall back, now! I'll bring up the rear!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: With my size... it's kind of hard to get through the door.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you should take a load off now that we finally got a break.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Seeing as both you and I have the day off from official business, how about we head out and shake ourselves off? Want to ride on my bike and catch the breeze, or maybe let's find some place to drink? It's your call. Oh, but, hehe, can't do both. Never drink and drive.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Phew, arrived on time. Didn't ride all that way for nothing—I was almost speeding, actually. Anyway, Doctor, happy birthday! I brought you a special pre—uh, where's my bag? I didn't drop it on the way, did I...? Ah, shoot. Doctor, how about I bring you the present next time, and I'll treat you to some food for today?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I might not be alongside Rhodes Island forever, but the camaraderie we built in battle, that's something the L.G.D., my Hannya, and me will remember. My commitment to protecting Rhodes Island will never change. Doctor, when times are troubled from here on, give me a call.
